adjudicated.labeler: Claude (one labeller; not dual-labelled, so the corpus is not golden)

labelNotes: Abs max: 'Supply voltage, VA' and 'Voltage on any Input Pin' both print 6.5 V MAX with no conditions, so they collapse to one label (value, unit, qualifier, conditions identical); cited on the supply row. The selected pages (5-7) do not reach the supply-current or digital-input rows of the Electrical Characteristics, so quiescent current and input leakage are ABSENT. Excluded: abs-max 'Input current at any pin' +/-10 mA and 'Package input current' +/-20 mA (stress ratings, not input leakage); ROC 'Digital Input Voltage' 5.5 V and VREFIN (not supply rails).
